name: zeffect_compute_distance_sq_to_listener
description: zEffect::ComputeDistanceSqToListener reads the listener world position, subtracts the input world position, and returns the single-precision squared distance.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session. Functional coverage checks the caller-visible squared distance and activation smoke coverage that consumes it.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja reconstruction and assembly for 0x462050 validate the gwNode::GetWorldPosition dependency, subtraction of worldPos from listener x/y/z, single-precision spill before squaring, and float squared-distance return.
The native distance smoke verifies listener position (4,6,8) against world position (1,2,3) returns 50.0. zeffect_init_smoke covers the runtime activation path that consumes the computed distance.
